en_note: Machine translation by Claude (my reading), not on Pesna.org and not checked by a native speaker. Treat it as a study aid.
translator_notes: Dialect of the Nevrokop/Razlog area (Pirin Macedonia). 'да постелеш, мале' is my reading (mother addressed mid-line). 'малкај мома' read as 'little girl'.

lines.en: where do you go, son, every evening,
Supper is waiting for you, son,

lines.cyr: да се врниш сине, да вечереш,
lines.lat: da se vrniš sine, da večereš,
lines.en: so you come back, son, and eat,

lines.cyr: да постелеш, мале, да си легнеш.
lines.lat: da posteleš, male, da si legneš.
lines.en: so you make the bed, mother, and lie down.

lines.cyr: - Ој ле, мале мори, стара мале,
lines.lat: - Oj le, male mori, stara male,

lines.cyr: штом ме питаш, мале, ќе ти кажам,
lines.lat: štom me pitaš, male, ḱe ti kažam,
lines.en: since you ask me, mother, I will tell you,

lines.cyr: тебе нема мале да те лажам.
lines.lat: tebe nema male da te lažam.
lines.en: I will not lie to you, mother.
By day I stroll, mother, around Nevrokop,

lines.cyr: ја по ноќа, мале, по разлошко,
lines.lat: ja po noḱa, male, po razloško,
lines.en: and by night, mother, around Razlog,
at the girls', mother, the pretty ones.
When there is no, mother, little girl,

lines.cyr: да ми каже мале, да вечерем,
lines.lat: da mi kaže male, da večerem,
lines.en: to tell me, mother, to have supper,

lines.cyr: до постеле, мале, да си легнем.
lines.lat: do postele, male, da si legnem.
lines.en: to the bed, mother, to lie down.
